name: 镜头畸变分析 (视频)
mechanism:
This method analyzes lens distortion consistency for video deepfake detection:

1. **Radial失真估计**: The camera's lens distortion parameters (barrel/pincushion distortion coefficients k1, k2, k3) are estimated from straight lines in the scene per frame. All objects captured through the same lens should show consistent radial distortion.

2. **人脸-Background失真比较**: Lens distortion should affect the face and background equally. The method estimates distortion independently from face geometry (curved features that should be straight) and background geometry (architectural lines, furniture edges). Mismatched distortion parameters indicate the face was captured/generated with a different optical system.

3. **失真时间稳定性**: For a fixed-lens camera (most video), distortion parameters should remain constant across all frames. The method tracks estimated parameters temporally. Variations in distortion — particularly in the face region — indicate frame-by-frame face generation that doesn't account for lens optics.

4. **失真Center验证**: Radial distortion is centered on the lens optical axis (typically near image center). All radial distortion in the image should share the same center point. Composited faces may show different effective distortion centers than the background.

5. **Chromatic失真Cross-Check**: Real lenses produce chromatic aberration (wavelength-dependent distortion). The method checks whether lateral chromatic aberration follows the expected pattern for the estimated lens model. Generated faces typically lack correct chromatic distortion, creating a detectable difference from the optically-captured background.
parameters:
分析类型: sensor
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through lens distortion analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
